title: Minimal Hypersurfaces with constant scalar curvature in $\mathbf{S}^6$
summary: In this paper, we propose certain assumptions on the principal curvatures for a closed minimal hypersurface $M^5$ in $\mathbf{S}^6$ to be isoparametric, provided that the functions $S, f_3,f_4$ are constants. Our result removes the nonnegative scalar curvature assumption as in Tang and Yan \cite{TY}. Finally, as a rigidity result, if $M^5\subset \mathbf{S}^6$ has a point with exactly two distinct principal curvatures, then it must be a Clifford torus.
